statements.title: Rivalries
statements.description: Two opposite or competing things, one on each end of a slider (e.g. Star Wars and Star Trek). Players pick a side, how strongly, or the exact middle.

middle.title: What the middle means
middle.description: Optional, e.g. "Star Wars and Star Trek are basically the same".

pointsPerAnswer.title: Points per answered rivalry
pointsPerAnswer.description: Awarded when the challenge closes. 0 = just for fun.
